topography.project_purpose: Risk Curators. Structurally: 31 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 4 ERC4626 vaults, 6 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin-upgradeable.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 2 common project-authored base contract(s) (ownable2step, proxy). Dominant framework: openzeppelin-upgradeable.
